rows.label: qst501802_msg0001
rows.name:
What I'm looking out for in this
auction is a Tome of Mors.

rows.label: qst501802_msg0002
rows.name:
It's mainly an auction of old books
written in Nopon, but I heard a Tome
of Mors will be listed.

rows.label: qst501802_msg0003
rows.name:
You've prepared plenty of funds too,
so let's make sure we win it!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0005
rows.name: Looks like it's about to begin.

rows.label: qst501802_msg0006
rows.name: Ooh, I'm getting a little nervous...

rows.label: qst501802_msg0007
rows.name: Next up is a Tome of Mors, mo!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0008
rows.name:
The writing is completely unreadable,
so nobody knows what it says, mo!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0009
rows.name:
But it's very thick, so it could at
least be used as a pickle stone, mo.

rows.label: qst501802_msg0010
rows.name: Bidding starts at 1G, mo!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0014
rows.name: Oohhhh!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0015
rows.name:
I'm not a fan of Nopon auctions.
They're always so lazily-paced.

rows.label: qst501802_msg0016
rows.name:
Everyone's reluctant to raise the
bid because they want to get things
for as cheap as they possibly can.

rows.label: qst501802_msg0017
rows.name: But I want that tome no matter what!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0018
rows.name:
You know how much we ought
to bid, right? Let's finish
this in one fell swoop!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0019
rows.name: How much should we bid?

rows.label: qst501802_msg0022
rows.name: Mo?!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0023
rows.name: Whoaaaa!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0024
rows.name: Amazing, mo!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0025
rows.name:
I hate to admit it, but 20G was my
limit, mo...

rows.label: qst501802_msg0032
rows.name: No way?!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0033
rows.name: Whoaaaa!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0034
rows.name: What a satisfying jump in price, mo!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0035
rows.name: I can't compete with that, mo...

rows.label: qst501802_msg0042
rows.name: Mo-mo-moooo?!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0043
rows.name:
Did you add an extra digit by
mistake, mo?

rows.label: qst501802_msg0044
rows.name:
Paying 30,000G for a pickle stone
like this is stupid, mo!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0045
rows.name:
What's so great about buying a book
you can't even read, mo?

rows.label: qst501802_msg0046
rows.name:
Heheh! Sounds like the words of
a bunch of sore losers to me!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0051
rows.name:
The winning bidder for the Tome of
Mors is that Blade over there, mo!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0052
rows.name:
Hahah! Thanks for that. This
is just what I wanted!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0053
rows.name:
I was impressed by your
decision, by the way.

rows.label: qst501802_msg0054
rows.name:
I thought we'd need around 100,000G,
you know.

rows.label: qst501802_msg0055
rows.name:
I'm glad we got it so cheaply.
Nice work!

rows.label: qst501802_msg0056
rows.name: Don't bid

rows.label: qst501802_msg0057
rows.name: Hey, come on... Really?

rows.label: qst501802_msg0058
rows.name:
We've come this far, so you
have to stay committed!
